memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "But when the magicians tried to produce gnats by their secret arts, they could not. Since the gnats were on people and animals everywhere, the magicians said to Pharaoh, "This is the finger of God." But Pharaoh's heart was hard and he would not listen, just as the Lord had said." - Exodus 8:18-19 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The magicians finally hit their limit. They tried, and they could not. And to their credit, they said so honestly: this is the finger of God.

Every counterfeit power eventually runs out. There is always a line it cannot cross. Egypt's finest could copy snakes, blood and frogs — but they could not make dust live. Creating life belongs to God alone.

The phrase they use is striking. Not the arm or the hand of God, but His finger. What was overwhelming an empire was, from heaven's side, effortless. Jesus later used the same expression, saying that if He drove out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God had come (Lk 11:20).

And yet — Pharaoh's heart was hard and he would not listen. His own advisors told him the truth. He still refused.

That is the tragedy of a hardened heart. It can hear the right diagnosis from a trusted voice and simply ignore it.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Who has told me the truth recently that I did not want to hear?
2. Where do I need to admit, "this is God" and stop resisting?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, give me ears to hear the truth even when it comes from unexpected people. Soften my heart before it hardens further. Amen.
